_comment: Written into a topic's .claude/settings.json by tools/create-topic.sh,
with {{SEED_DIR}} replaced by the absolute path of this repo.
The PreToolUse matcher is '*' on purpose: role_gate.py is an allowlist,
and an allowlist that only runs on some tools is not an allowlist. With a
narrower matcher every MCP tool reaches the model ungated.
Both hooks read the role from AGENTPORT_ROLE, or from the file named by
AGENTPORT_ROLE_FILE. The launcher exports the latter as <topic>/.current-role,
which is the same file the channel adapters rewrite before delivering each
inbound message. Unset means contributor — it fails closed.
